# ravenna_tag (Resource)

A tag applied to Ravenna tickets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ravenna_tag" "hardware" {
  name        = "hardware"
  color       = "blue"
  description = "Requests involving physical equipment"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `color` (String) Tag colour. One of the Ravenna palette values.
- `name` (String) Tag name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Tag identifier.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace that owns the tag.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ravenna_tag.hardware t_01HXYZ
```
